== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Timer Mine (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Timer Mine]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_esb_2pg_japanese/timer_mine__lightside_japanese_white_border/48918 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/abc4815a670d460ca3efe1a5bc655c2c/IMG_20220607_0112.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(4, 8, 778, 1046)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9bbd2988a259f540429053955ffa94f55cdb2d705114a5aa52dbffe69f6e6fae</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
